kit_maker.title: Kit Maker · J Dilla inspired MIDI loops
kit_maker.description: Unofficial inspired loops, not measured original J Dilla recordings; missing grid points reconstructed by the approved model.
model_assumptions: Same origin tick for all voices; measured onsets never individually realigned.
A selected four-quarter-note bar repeats; no multi-bar averaging or folding.
Candidate phase periods 1/2/4/8 compared by leave-one-observed-position-out error within the source family/voice, before quantization; simpler periods win ties.
Missing offsets interpolate between anchors in the same rhythmic phase, including cyclic wrap; an entirely unobserved phase falls back to adjacent voice anchors.
Model validation compares observations from that voice only; it does not prove reconstructed points or their new inter-voice relationships.
One-anchor grids extrapolate a constant offset; especially weak evidence.
Nearest sixteenth assignment is analytical, not proof of originally intended rhythm; ties blocked.
Missing voices have no template, not a straight placeholder.
Interpolation describes hypothetical new notes, not observations from the recording.
Range compatibility concerns storage only, not known scheduler/choke/ratchet bugs or physical timing.

patches.title: pATCHES · D’Angelo Groove Pack
patches.description: Static authored timing only; original RandomAmount and VelocityAmount are not applied.

semantics.mapping_evidence: Official LOM base3=1/16; same Grid3 in local explicitly named MPC3000 16 Swing AGRs. LOM docs are newer than source Live9.7.3; no Live application was executed.
semantics.operation: Apply authored TimingAmount to source offsets from the nominal sixteenth grid, then infer missing positions and quantize once.
semantics.quantize: Destination reference is already on a1/16 grid, so pre-quantization has no displacement. Existing microtiming is replaced, not passed through an Ableton Quantize transformation.
semantics.random_velocity: Source RandomAmount and VelocityAmount retained as provenance; not applied. Static timing templates preserve destination velocity and other parameters.
semantics.native_decoder_validation: Packed nibbles checked against previously emulated frozen v0.3 native decoder truth table; no new physical test.
